UKHC010105742026
CRLA No. 357 of 2026
Aslam Alias Vinod Bisht
--Appellant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand
--Respondent
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Ankurit Raj Davi, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
2. Mr. Rakesh Negi, learned Brief Holder for the 
State. 
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties on Delay 
Condonation Application (IA No. 1 of 2026). 
4. There is a delay of 502 days in filing the 
present appeal. 
5. Learned counsel for the appellant would 
submit that the appellant belongs to Rajasthan, hence 
his family members could not come forward to do 
pairvi of his case; appellant is in jail since 
24.08.2024, therefore, the aforesaid delay has 
occurred. 
6. It is not objected to by the learned State 
counsel. 
7. There are good grounds to condone the delay  in filing the appeal. The delay in filing the appeal is 
hereby condoned and the Delay Condonation 
Application (IA No. 1 of 2026) is allowed. 
8. Heard. 
9. Admit. 
10. Call for LCR. 
11. Once the LCR is received, let the paper book 
be prepared and provided to the learned counsel for 
the parties, as per Rules. 
12. List on 04.08.2026. 
13. Meanwhile, objections to the Bail Application 
(IA No. 2 of 2026) be filed by the State counsel. 
 (Siddhartha Sah, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.) 
 29.06.2026
Shiv/
